lessons: Review found the neighbors implementation in clutch/index.py matched the spec. Redo it the same way from the merge base. The only gaps were missing assertions in tests/unit/test_index_neighbors.py.

Criterion 5: test two separate creators. The first fails only load(conn, "vss") and asserts findings == ("embed_failed: vss unavailable: x", "fts unavailable: index missing"). The second fails only load(conn, "fts") with an embed failure present and asserts findings[1] == "fts unavailable: y".

Criterion 5: for the vss-unavailable, fts-load-failure and embeddings-table-missing cases, assert the full (outcome, mode, hits, findings) tuple: fulltext_unavailable, "", (), and the exact findings. The earlier attempt did this only for the exec-reply cases.

Criterion 4: for the database with no chunks table, assert outcome == "index_unreadable" and findings[0].startswith("index_unreadable: "). Do the same for the connect-raises case and the not-a-database case.
Before finishing, go through criteria 1-9 clause by clause and check that each named case has its own assert on every field the criterion lists. Do not combine failure modes in one fixture.
